### Result

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant
issue/OpenSpec change when one exists.

### Validation

List commands actually run and their results, including a regression check where
needed. Explain checks not run. Offline tests do not establish live acceptance.

### Limits and compatibility

Describe migration, affected platforms, user-file preservation and remaining
limits. Record source/version/license for new external material. Include no
secrets, private transcripts or model credentials.
